claims.text: Image the head for more than brief impaired consciousness, GCS < 15, focal findings, persistent vomiting, seizures, any loss of consciousness, or a suspected fracture.
claims.quote: Imaging should always be done in patients with more than transiently impaired consciousness, GCS score < 15, focal neurologic findings, persistent vomiting, seizures, a history of loss of consciousness, or clinically suspected fractures.
